integrity: Exact general proof for order-convex disagreement sets and probability spectrum, with an exhaustive finite verification of the four-variable distance enumerator and a separate recursive truth-function enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Classical positive propositional formulas over conjunction and disjunction, no constants; finite four-variable histogram only; no claim that all higher-arity distance distributions are known. Historical priority remains open to an independent literature audit. Dvorkin permits Boolean constants while the theorem deliberately omits them; no claim is made for the modal extension.
title: Convex disagreement sets and exact four-variable frequencies for positive formulas
